WITH ss_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN 'bucket1' 
             WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN 'bucket2' 
             WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN 'bucket3' 
             WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 THEN 'bucket4' 
             WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN 'bucket5' END AS bucket,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt,
        AVG(ss_ext_tax) AS avg_ext_tax,
        AVG(ss_net_paid_inc_tax) AS avg_net_paid_inc_tax
    FROM store_sales
    WHERE r_reason_sk = 1
    GROUP BY 
        CASE WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN 'bucket1' 
             WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 21 AND 40 THEN 'bucket2' 
             WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 41 AND 60 THEN 'bucket3' 
             WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 61 AND 80 THEN 'bucket4' 
             WHEN ss_quantity BETWEEN 81 AND 100 THEN 'bucket5' END
)
SELECT 
    MAX(CASE WHEN bucket = 'bucket1' THEN cnt ELSE NULL END) > 1071 AS bucket1,
    MAX(CASE WHEN bucket = 'bucket2' THEN cnt ELSE NULL END) > 39161 AS bucket2,
    MAX(CASE WHEN bucket = 'bucket3' THEN cnt ELSE NULL END) > 29434 AS bucket3,
    MAX(CASE WHEN bucket = 'bucket4' THEN cnt ELSE NULL END) > 6568 AS bucket4,
    MAX(CASE WHEN bucket = 'bucket5' THEN cnt ELSE NULL END) > 21216 AS bucket5
FROM ss_stats
